DIN adapter plates

Black PETG plates between your bought DIN clips (blue ghost) and the parts (grey ghost). Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom.

TB6600 plate (×3)

  • A 3 mm organic frame: a spine under the wall, two seat ribs, and curved struts between them. About 23 cm³.
  • The driver sits on the two ribs, 8 above the clip. Each rib carries an insert pad.
  • The clip screws into M3 heat-set inserts pressed in from underside, 5 deep in 8 tall pads.
  • Two posts take the flange. The slot runs 8–20 mm above the seat, with a nut channel outside.

Board plate (×1)

  • A 4 mm organic frame: struts flow from the 4 board bosses to the 4 insert pads, with two sweeping braces. About 18 cm³, half the earlier version.
  • Insert pads 8 tall. The bosses rise to 12, which leaves 4 mm between the PCB's underside and the pads.
  • Board holes are Ø6 float holes (about ±1.3) for an M3 with washer and nut underneath.

Need from you

  • Clip thickness at the screw holes, so I can size the flat-head M3 screws (thickness + about 5): unmeasured.
  • Your M3 heat-set inserts: length and outer diameter. I've assumed M3 × 5 in the Ø4.2 bore that coupon A tests.
  • Height from the rail's base to the clip's top face when it's clipped on. My guess is about 16 (unverified).
